title: 第一卷 第22章 硬撼威压，再惊众人
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
炼气九层的灵力威压，对于普通炼气二层修士而言，堪称灭顶之势。

    轻则气血翻涌、站立不稳，重则经脉受创、当场受伤。

    林辰面带冷笑，笃定眼前的百岁老者必定会不堪重压，当众出丑。

    然而下一刻，他脸上的笑意便凝固了。

    威压笼罩之下，苏玄尘依旧静静伫立原地。

    身形不晃，脚步不移。

    灰白长发被气流微微吹动，周身气息依旧平缓柔和，看不出半分吃力。

    仿佛那足以碾压低层修士的灵力威压，落在他身上，如同清风拂面。

    “嗯？”林辰瞳孔微微一缩，心中满是诧异。

    怎么可能？

    一个肉身朽坏、修为仅有炼气二层的老者，竟然能硬扛自己的威压？

    围观的弟子也炸开了锅，窃窃私语声再度响起。

    “不对劲啊！他怎么一点事都没有？”

    “林师兄可是炼气九层巅峰，威压何等强横，寻常炼气四层都扛不住！”

    “难道传闻是真的？这极品天灵根，当真有独到之处？”

    众人的议论声传入耳中，林辰脸色愈发难看。

    他本想当众折辱对方，没想到反而让对方展露了不俗的韧性。

    “有点门道。”林辰语气沉了下来，“看来你并非只会躲在宗门里仰仗长老庇护。不过，单凭这点韧性，还远远不够。”

    话音未落，他暗中催动灵力，威压再度暴涨三分。

    滚滚灵力化作实质，朝着苏玄尘疯狂挤压而去。

    这一次，连周围不少炼气五层、六层的弟子，都感觉呼吸一滞，连忙向后退开数步。

    苏玄尘眉头微不可察地一蹙。

    对方刻意发难，一味退让只会让对方得寸进尺。

    他不再单纯被动防御。

    体内潜藏的灵力缓缓运转。

    依旧是炼气二层的境界，可灵力凝练程度，却远超同阶，甚至比起林辰都要纯粹数倍。

    精纯灵力遍布周身，化作一层无形屏障。

    外界狂暴的威压撞在屏障之上，层层消解，再难侵入半分。
content_en:
The spiritual pressure of the ninth level of Qi Refining is extremely overwhelming for ordinary second-level Qi Refining monks.

    It ranges from surging Qi and blood and unsteady standing to severe injuries to the meridians and injuries on the spot.

    Lin Chen had a sneer on his face, convinced that the centenarian in front of him would be overwhelmed and make a fool of himself in public.

    However, the next moment, the smile on his face solidified.

    Under the pressure, Su Xuanchen still stood quietly.

    The body does not waver and the steps do not move.

    The long gray hair was slightly blown by the airflow, and the breath around her body was still smooth and soft, and there was no sign of any exertion.

    It was as if the spiritual pressure, which was enough to crush the lower-level monks, fell on him like a breeze blowing on his face.

    "Huh?" Lin Chen's pupils shrank slightly, and he was full of surprise.

    How is that possible?

    How could an old man with a decayed body and only the second level of Qi Refining be able to withstand his own pressure?

    The disciples who were watching also exploded, and the whispers started again.

    "Something's wrong! Why is there nothing wrong with him?"

    "Senior Brother Lin is at the pinnacle of the ninth level of Qi Refining. His pressure is so tyrannical that even the ordinary fourth level of Qi Refining cannot withstand it!"

    "Are the rumors true? Is this top-grade Tianlinggen really unique?"

    Lin Chen's face became increasingly ugly as the people's comments reached his ears.

    He originally wanted to humiliate the other party in public, but unexpectedly, he made the other party show great resilience.

    "You have some skills." Lin Chen's tone became calmer. "It seems that you don't just hide in the sect and rely on the elders for protection. However, this resilience alone is not enough."

    Before he finished speaking, he secretly activated his spiritual power, and his pressure surged by three points again.

    The billowing spiritual power turned into substance and squeezed crazily towards Su Xuanchen.

    This time, even many of the disciples on the fifth and sixth levels of Qi Refining around them felt their breathing stagnant and quickly took a few steps back.

    Su Xuanchen frowned imperceptibly.

    The other party deliberately attacks, and blindly giving in will only allow the other party to make further progress.

    He is no longer purely passive defensive.

    The spiritual power hidden in the body circulates slowly.

    He is still at the second level of Qi Refining, but his level of spiritual power concentration is far higher than that of the same level, and is even several times more pure than Lin Chen.

    Pure spiritual power spreads all over the body, turning into an invisible barrier.

    The violent coercion from the outside world collides with the barrier, dissolving layer by layer, making it difficult to invade even half a point.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 22 Overcome the pressure and surprise everyone again
